body: Create a high-contrast conceptual wordmark for the exact word "MELT". Integrate melting into the letter structures themselves: lower stems become controlled downward wax drips while all four letters remain legible and inseparable from the metaphor. Black wordmark on warm white, one small explanatory line underneath reading exactly "Letters soften into motion." No unrelated symbols or mockup. Square composition.
